### Time with God - August 22, 2017
Author: John North
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-august-22-2017.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 24:24
Points:
- When instructed to build an altar, David refused free land and animals because he would not sacrifice what cost him nothing.
- Authentic worship must carry a genuine personal cost rather than settling for convenience or handouts.
- Believers fall into cheap worship when they attend services disengaged, withholding their full attention, praise, and prayers.
- Cheap devotion also shows up when giving grudgingly, ignoring the needs of others, or avoiding evangelism due to embarrassment.
- God calls His followers to offer costly worship by surrendering their time, dreams, and lives to His kingdom.
